```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```


```{r example event study}
# Load the following packages -------------
packages <- c("stargazer", 
              "dplyr", 
              "haven",
              "fixest",    
              "plm",         
              "lubridate",   
              "broom"        
              )
if (!requireNamespace("pacman", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("pacman")
pacman::p_load(packages, character.only = TRUE)

# Load the sample data set --------------
data <- read_dta("https://github.com/worldbank/r-econ-visual-library/raw/master/Library/Data/nlsw88.dta")
dir.create("Outputs", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)  # to create a new folder

# Create the data frame --------------
df_event <- data %>%
  select(idcode,
         wage,           # Outcome variable
         hours,          # Alternative outcome  
         union,          # Treatment/event variable
         age,            # Control variables
         married,
         ttl_exp,
         collgrad,
         south,
         industry) %>%
  filter(!is.na(wage), !is.na(union)) %>%

  # remove the following simulation of a time variable when you have an actual time variable
  mutate(
    time_period = case_when(
      age <= 30 ~ "Pre-event (-2)",
      age > 30 & age <= 35 ~ "Pre-event (-1)", 
      age > 35 & age <= 40 ~ "Event (0)",
      age > 40 & age <= 45 ~ "Post-event (+1)",
      age > 45 ~ "Post-event (+2)"
    ),
    pre_2 = ifelse(time_period == "Pre-event (-2)", 1, 0),
    pre_1 = ifelse(time_period == "Pre-event (-1)", 1, 0),
    event_0 = ifelse(time_period == "Event (0)", 1, 0),
    post_1 = ifelse(time_period == "Post-event (+1)", 1, 0),
    post_2 = ifelse(time_period == "Post-event (+2)", 1, 0),
    treat_pre_2 = union * pre_2,
    treat_pre_1 = union * pre_1,
    treat_event = union * event_0,
    treat_post_1 = union * post_1,
    treat_post_2 = union * post_2
  )

# Run the Event Study Models ------------------------------
# Model 1: Basic event study (no controls)
model1 <- lm(wage ~ treat_pre_2 + treat_pre_1 + treat_event + treat_post_1 + treat_post_2 + 
             pre_2 + pre_1 + event_0 + post_1 + post_2 + union, 
             data = df_event)

# Model 2: With individual controls
model2 <- lm(wage ~ treat_pre_2 + treat_pre_1 + treat_event + treat_post_1 + treat_post_2 + 
             pre_2 + pre_1 + event_0 + post_1 + post_2 + union +
             age + married + ttl_exp + collgrad + south, 
             data = df_event)

# Model 3: Alternative outcome (hours)
model3 <- lm(hours ~ treat_pre_2 + treat_pre_1 + treat_event + treat_post_1 + treat_post_2 + 
             pre_2 + pre_1 + event_0 + post_1 + post_2 + union +
             age + married + ttl_exp + collgrad + south, 
             data = df_event)

stargazer(model1,
          model2,
          model3,
          title = "Event Study: Dynamic Effects of Union Membership",
          column.labels = c("Wage", "Wage", "Hours"),
          covariate.labels = c("Treatment × Pre-event (-2)",
                              "Treatment × Pre-event (-1)", 
                              "Treatment × Event (0)",
                              "Treatment × Post-event (+1)",
                              "Treatment × Post-event (+2)",
                              "Pre-event (-2)",
                              "Pre-event (-1)",
                              "Event (0)", 
                              "Post-event (+1)",
                              "Post-event (+2)",
                              "Treatment (Union)",
                              "Age",
                              "Married",
                              "Total experience", 
                              "College graduate",
                              "Lives in South",
                              "Constant"),
          keep = c("treat_", "pre_", "event_", "post_", "union"),  # Keep only event study coefficients
          dep.var.labels.include = FALSE,
          dep.var.caption = "",
          keep.stat = c("n", "adj.rsq"),
          header = FALSE,
          notes = c("Standard errors in parentheses.",
                   "Event study coefficients show treatment effects relative to baseline.",
                   "Pre-event coefficients test for parallel trends assumption.",
          "* p < 0.05, ** p < 0.01, *** p < 0.001"),
          notes.append = FALSE,
          out = "Outputs/event-study.tex")
```
